Done! Added invoice text rendering with 7 new tests. All 59 tests pass ✓

**New file: src/render.js**
- `renderInvoiceText(invoice)` — renders an invoice as plain text with:
  - First line: invoice number or "DRAFT"
  - Second line: customer name
  - One line per item: `<qty>x <name> @ <unitPrice> = <total>`
  - Total line

All amounts formatted via `formatEuros()` with thousands separators and proper decimal precision.
